description: Réseau T2C : Arrêts de bus et tramway is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Clermont Auvergne Métropole. T2C network: Bus and tram stops. Coverage: Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "T2C network: Bus and tram stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2024-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
